On The 14th Of August, 2024
 Writ Petition No. 22709 of 2024
 Smt. Babli Yadav
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh And Others
 Appearance:
 Shri Ranjan Banerjee - Advocate for petitioner.
 Shri Swapnil Ganguly - Deputy Advocate General for respond
 Order

This petition under Article 226 of Constitution of India has been filed seeking the following reliefs:
"i) That this Hon'ble Court may kindly be pleased to issue a writ of Mandamus and direct the Respondent No.4 Station House Officer, PS Nowgaon to register crime number on the basis of the report first information report and other documents in the present case against the accused namely Bharat Yadav and Ashish Tiwari.
ii) That this Hon'ble Court may kindly be pleased to direct the Respondent No. 4 to acquire samples for DNA Test from the body.
iii) That this Hon'ble Court may kindly be pleased to take strict action against the Respondent No.4 looking to his attitude of not complying with the directions and orders issued by this Hon'ble Court and also by Chief Judicial Magistrate,
Chhatarpur.
iv) Issue any other writ, order or direction as this Hon'ble Court deems fit may also kindly be awarded in favour of the petitioner."

sentences.text:
It is submitted by counsel for petitioner that petitioner was raped by NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2024:MPHC-JBP:40508 2 WP-22709-2024 Bharat Yadav and Ashish Tiwari but the Investigating Officer did not lodge the report.

Only after intervention by the senior officers, Crime No.38/2024 was registered at Police Station Nowgaon, District Chhatarpur for offence under Sections 376-D,
506 of IPC.
Thereafter, Investigating Officer filed a closure report which was not accepted by the concerning Magistrate and the police was directed to conduct further investigation.
It is submitted that thereafter no action has been taken by the Investigating Officer and therefore, the present petition has been filed.

3. Counsel for the State has already sought written instructions from S.H.O., Police Station Nowgaon, District Chhatarpur and submitted that final report (closure/challan) shall be filed before the concerning Court within a period of one week.
4. A copy of written instructions issued from S.H.O., Police Station Nowgaon, District Chhatarpur has also been provided by Shri Swapnil Ganguly which is taken on record.
5. In view of the abovementioned submissions made by counsel for the State, nothing survives in the writ petition.
6. Accordingly, it is disposed of under hope and belief that final report (closure/challan) shall be filed within a period of one week from today.

(G. S. AHLUWALIA) JUDGE vc Smt. Babli Yadav vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 14 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/60834418/
